title: Wren and the Oath
author: Juniper Montrose
blurb: Cyrus Galloway, a hedge-witch's runaway apprentice, has never left the valley where magic cannot follow. But when the crown announces a hunt for anyone with the gift, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, he must find the door out of a country that no longer exists before the usurper's armies reach the free cities.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
